authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5 multiplies by 1000 for the per-mille character, giving 99500; the per-mille sign is the passive suffix (4.7.4). XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: "If (after making the above adjustments) the minimum-integer-part-size and the minimum-fractional-part-size are both zero, then the minimum-fractional-part-size is set to 1 (one)".
